recipes.name: Amazing Crusted Chicken
ingredients_raw: 2 cups cheese flavored crackers (such as Cheez-It®), crushed
salt and ground black pepper to taste
4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut in half

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Coat a baking dish with cooking spray.
Combine crackers, onions, bread crumbs, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper in a bowl; set aside.

Wash and pat dry chicken breasts. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on one side of each breast; press into cracker mixture, mayonnaise-side down. Spread a thin layer of mayonnaise on other side of each breast; cover with cracker mixture, patting firmly until it adheres. Place coated chicken breasts into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle remaining cracker mixture on top; lightly coat chicken with cooking spray.

Bake in the preheated oven until breasts are no longer pink in centers and the juices run clear, 35 to 40 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Amazing Crusted Chicken
raw_recipe.description: For this amazing crusted chicken recipe, chicken breasts are coated with mayonnaise, cheese-flavored crackers, French-fried onions, and sesame seeds.

video.description: Cheese crackers and French fried onions make the crispy coating on this baked chicken!

review.reviewBody: I tried this because I wanted something different & new for my boneless chicken breasts. And my husband is a "comfort food" style eater. So I thought he'd like it. It was delicious!! Because the chicken breasts are coated really good, they are so moist and tender! I always cut the chicken breasts in half lengthwise. Makes them easier to eat, shorter to cook & always moist. I followed the directions exactly as written. Only difference, I cooked for about 20 minutes at 375. And that was plenty of time. Because the chicken was sliced thinner. My husband loved it! So did our son! Thanks for the recipe!

After reading multiple reviews with suggestions, there were minimal things that I changed. I wouldn't feel right about completely changing the recipe, then giving less than 5 stars! The one, awesome tip that I got from some of the reviews was to use the food processor to crush the crackers and the onions. Works like a charm, and I saved so much time by doing it that way! The only things that I changed was left out the sesame seeds from the breading, and used 1 1/2 cups of cheese flavored crackers (we used the Italian 4 cheese), and 1 1/2 cups French-fried onion rings (our family loves onions!), and added garlic powder to the breading. I’ve started adding seasonings that our family likes to the Mayo prior to slathering the breasts with it, then let the chicken “marinate” for a couple days prior to cooking. This was a game changer! My family truly enjoyed this chicken. As an added note, no one in our family is a big fan of mayo, but I still used it (with added seasonings). Honestly, we could not taste the mayo. Thank you for a great recipe, Chefbound!
The one ingredient I changed was th mayo, I used the Hidden Valley Ranch dressing to add a bit more flavor, it was delish!!!

Amazing. I’ve made dozens of coated chicken recipes. This is one of the best. Made only 3 slight modifications: cut breast’s in half and pounded even; used 1/2 Mayonnaise and 1/2 Dijon; and, critically, 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes. This was so good, made it 2 nights in a row. Thanks

It is tasty but needs to be cooked at a lower temp to avoid burning; pre-heated oven at 425 for 25 mins works well for thicker breasts, and maybe 20 mins if they are average size. The other change is there really is no need to add salt considering how much sodium is in the cheezits, and for those looking to cut down a bit on the fat it's easy to swap out dipping the chicken in egg whites before the breading step instead of using mayo. Overall quick and tasty recipe.

I used bacon and cheese flavored crackers but followed the recipe otherwise. I had no problem with the crust being a bit moist, but I put the chicken on a rack and basted it with melted bacon fat and melted butter instead of laying it in the pan to bake.

Came out excellent!!!

I put the crackers and fried onions through the blender, and added some garlic, old bay and cayenne. I didn't think the bread crumbs were needed. I turned them over half way through the baking. Loved the end result. Son dipped them in ranch.

I made this for dinner tonight. My grown daughter said, "this is amazing". She did not know that the recipe title included the word amazing. I had to make some changes because I didn't have all of the ingredients. I had to use Ritz Crackers instead of cheese crackers. So I threw in a half cup of shredded extra sharp cheese. I didn't have Italian Bread crumbs so I used a half teaspoon of Italian seasoning a half teaspoon of garlic powder and a half teaspoon of onion powder. I left out the sesame seeds because I didn't have those either. I'm only telling all of this to let everyone know you can make many changes to this recipe and it is still delicious. I did bake it at 350 degrees instead of the recommended temperature.

My husband laughed when I told him I was making "Cheez-It Chicken, but changed his mind after he tasted it! It was really good. I had two large chicken breasts and cut them in half lengthwise. I substituted 1 Tbls of Mayo with chipotle aioli, you could just add some hot sauce, and cooked them at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. They came out perfectly cooked and I will make this again. Thanks for the recipe.

Used chicken thighs out of breasts. It was tasty and it is a comfort food aka not something to eat daily as come on it’s not the healthiest but it sure is tasty. I don’t understand giving 1 star cause it’s high in everything- do you give cakes or pies 1 star cause it’s high in everything that makes it yummy? Simply don’t make or eat it. Ok, off my soap box now. Enjoy the recipe though

This was delicious. I split the chicken breast long ways and seasoned more than indicated. Baked 20 mins
350’... next day reheated left overs in dry cast iron 
Skillet till warmed thru. Hubby said he liked it better
The second day ... will definitely make again..

I've made this recipe twice now following the recipe exactly as written with 2 small exceptions I didn't have any sesame seed and I salted the chicken before putting the mayo on. It was undoubtedly the BEST baked chicken either of us had ever eaten! ! ! Super moist and fork tender -- leave the knives in the drawer for this one ! !
Made this tonight and my husband says its his new favorite way to have chicken! We loved it! Followed the recipe exactly but I did not have the sesame seeds so I did not use those :)
Very bland. I expected more flavor from the cheese crackers, onions, italian bread crumbs. Also it wasn't "crusted" it was just loose crumbs on top and mushy on the bottom!

We really enjoyed it. I used chicken thighs with skin on and bone in. One problem I found was using my Nuwave oven (I call it my easy bake oven... Lol). Because of its small size the top of the chicken started to burn. The top element is to close to the meat even with the rack on the lowest setting. I resolved the problem by putting a piece of foil over the chicken shinny side up. I recommend using a standard oven to do this recipe.

I've been making this for a long time. It's one of the go-to dinners in heavy rotation. I like to pound them out to make them cook evenly. It's a good idea to put the mayonnaise that you're using in a bowl first. You don't want to cross contaminate the jar of mayonnaise with raw chicken.

I made this recipe for dinner & served it with a lettuce salad. I made it per recipe other than I forgot the bread crumbs. I also added garlic powder & onion power in the breading. It baked for 40 minutes. The chicken was tender, though not really juicy nor not dry. My husband & I thought it was missing some other seasoning. Like a dash of cayenne pepper, more salt? If I make it again I will add more seasoning.

Used panko crumbs with Italian bread crumbs added parmesan and Romano cheese to the bread crumbs. Also used miracle whip and dijon mustard instead of mayo. Grated fresh garlic 3 cloves 2 tsp dry basil
It turned out delicious even though I think mine was slightly over cooked but it was very tender. I will definitely serve this again!!

Aptly named! This was delicious. We pigged out until we couldn’t move. The Mayo and the coating kept the chicken moist. Served with oven roasted vegetables and this was perfectly yummy. Thank you for sharing the recipe.
